{{Short description|British academic in epidemic modelling}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}

'''Matthew James Keeling''' {{postnominals|country=GBR|size=100%|OBE}} (born June 1970) is a professor in the Mathematics Institute and the School of Life Sciences of the [[University of Warwick]]. He has been the editor of the journal ''[[Epidemics (journal)|Epidemics]]'' since 2007.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Professor Matt Keeling|url=https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/sci/lifesci/people/mkeeling/|website=warwick.ac.uk|access-date=2020-05-15}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Prof Matt Keeling|url=https://warwick.ac.uk/fac/sci/maths/people/staff/matt_keeling/|website=warwick.ac.uk|access-date=2020-05-15}}</ref>

Keeling was appointed [[Officer of the Order of the British Empire]] (OBE) in the [[2021 Birthday Honours]] for services to SAGE during the [[COVID-19]] response.<ref>{{London Gazette|issue=63377|supp=y|page=B12|date=12 June 2021}}</ref>

==Awards==
* [[Philip Leverhulme Prize]] in Mathematics (2005)
* Royal Zoological Society of London, Scientific Medal (2007)
